name: Nakadashi Teatime ~Meshimase Cream Pie~
original_name: 中出しティータイム・召しませクリームパイ
source:
A merry coffee shop during daytime offers special exclusive menu at night called "Cream Pie set". Main character gets to know about this secret and starts to treat waitresses differently.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
白天热闹欢快的咖啡店，到了夜晚会提供名为“中出套餐”的独家特殊菜单。主人公得知这个秘密后，开始以不同的方式对待女服务员们。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
